summary: The sealed Jinshu 80 opening dates Wang Xizhi’s age as thirteen sui and ties later staff service to Yu Liang’s deathbed, but most Western intervals are invented career-spans rather than uncertainty about one event. Yu Liang’s deathbed memorial and death in 咸康六年 convert to AD 340, and his 征西將軍 tenure after Tao Kan’s 咸和九年 death supports a 334–340 window for the recruitment; Emperor Yuan’s 過江 and Wang Kuang’s advice belong to 永嘉元年 (AD 307). Closed ranges 316–322 / 317–322 for 幼 and 年十三 invent a start from dynasty founding or a reconstructed birth and ignore that 幼 precedes the visit, which is only bounded by Zhou Yi’s 永昌元年 death. 司徒導 and 尚書郎 are identifications, not dated service; Wang Dao became 司徒 in 太寧元年 (323), not 317. 時太尉郗鑒 cannot be 327–339: the Chengdi annals make Xi Jian 太尉 only in 咸康四年 (338) and record his death in 咸康五年. Wang Dun-circle dates 317–324 describe activity until 太寧二年, not the undated praise, clerkship, or 三少 remark. Hints must follow the supported personal events, not reign-long or dynasty-long activity. No birth year should be inferred from 年十三; s0021–s0022 remain undated after the 340 memorial.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi was thirteen sui when he called on Zhou Yi.
itemChecks.reason: The chapter states 年十三 for Wang Xizhi himself and the claim keeps sui reckoning without converting the inclusive age into a birth year. Owner is p001; this is an age attestation, not a Western life date.

evidence.quote: 年十三，嘗謁周顗，顗察而異之。

itemChecks.event: Yu Liang died after composing a deathbed memorial that praised Wang Xizhi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p013. 亮臨薨 in this chapter is Yu Liang’s own dying moment; Jinshu 成帝紀 and 庾亮傳 date that death to 咸康六年正月庚子. Conventional Chengdi 咸康六年 is AD 340. The death falls in lunar month 1, so the Western year is 340 in both Julian and proleptic Gregorian; Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 Julian default does not move the year near this New Year. Year precision is appropriate because the chapter itself has no month/day.

evidence.quote: 亮臨薨，上疏稱羲之清貴有鑒裁。

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi, at thirteen sui, visited Zhou Yi and first became known after the ox-heart roast.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. The source gives 年十三 but no reign year. AD 316–322 invents both a start (Eastern Jin founding or a reconstructed birth such as 303+13) and a closed career window. Zhou Yi’s 永昌元年 death supplies only an onOrBefore 322 bound; 幼 then 年十三 forbids treating the visit as a 316–322 activity span, and sui age must not be turned into a precise birth year.

evidence.quote: 年十三，嘗謁周顗，顗察而異之。
顗先割啖羲之，於是始知名。

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. 幼 is a life-stage before 年十三, with no year. Dating it AD 317–322 copies Zhou Yi’s last Eastern Jin years and makes childhood simultaneous with the age-thirteen visit. The window describes dynasty-period activity, not uncertainty about one undated boyhood remark.

evidence.quote: 羲之幼訥於言，人未之奇。

itemChecks.event: After growing up, Wang Xizhi was valued by his uncles and later entered office under Yu Liang.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. 及長 is a life-stage, not a dated event. AD 324–340 joins Wang Dun’s 太寧二年 death to Yu Liang’s 咸康六年 death and treats early adulthood as activity throughout those years. s0009–s0010 have no year; s0019 belongs to the separate 征西 recruitment.

Mingdi annals first make him 司徒 in 太寧元年 (323); Chengdi annals move him from 司徒 to 太傅/丞相 in 咸康四年. Do not invent a second endpoint from a title label.

references.title: 晉書/卷007 成帝紀 咸康五年八月
references.reason: Xi Jian died as 太尉 in 咸康五年 (AD 339), the latest year a contemporaneous 太尉 matchmaking could occur.

references.title: 晉書/卷007 成帝紀 咸康六年
references.quote: 六年春正月庚子，使持节、都督江豫益梁雍交广七州诸军事、司空、都亭侯庾亮薨。
references.reason: Primary date for Yu Liang’s death: 咸康六年正月庚子, conventional AD 340. Lunar month 1 stays in Western 340.

references.title: 晉書/卷073 庾亮傳
references.quote: 陶侃薨，迁亮都督江、荆、豫、益、梁、雍六州诸军事，领江、荆、豫三州刺史，进号征西将军
references.reason: Shows 征西將軍 begins after Tao Kan’s death, justifying 334 as the early bound of claim-167.

references.title: 晉書/卷073 庾亮傳
references.quote: 咸康六年薨，时年五十二。
references.reason: Biography witness that 亮臨薨 belongs to 咸康六年, not a later commemoration.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Calendar convention: the converter defaults to Julian before 1582. Year-precision claims here use conventional reign years (永嘉元年=307, 咸和九年=334, 咸康四至六年=338–340). 正月 deaths do not cross the Western year; a live day conversion was not obtained because the posted converter was interrupted.
